title: An overview of entry-level certifications: CompTIA A+, Linux+ and Network+

videos.script: Job adverts for support roles often ask for a certification. Three that often appear at entry level come from the same organisation, CompTIA: A plus, Network plus and Linux plus. {{three}} A certification says one thing: that on a given day you passed an exam about a published list of topics. It does not say you have done the work, and employers know that. {{says}} This lesson goes through what each of the three covers, where this track already took you, and how to prepare without wasting money. {{each}} The details change with every version of each exam, so the lesson also shows where to check them. {{check}}
